correctness.rationale: The complete observation records every contiguous substring length and ones count with multiplicity. The package source build_census.cpp and verify_independent.cpp group exact full byte signatures, choosing one canonical representative of each reversal orbit and restoring word multiplicity 1 or 2; counter indices exhaust n(n+3)/2 entries without overflow for n<=23. Independently compiled a separate 23-bit complete-signature enumerator, which ran over all 8,388,608 words via 4,196,192 canonical classes and produced exactly 4,096 singleton, 4,191,936 double, and 160 quadruple fibers: weighted sum 8,388,608. Separate independent Python enumeration matched n=8,11,12,14. Consequently the optimal zero-error code cardinality is the exact count of fiber classes. This certifies only finite n<=23, not all binary lengths; the 160 length-23 witness rows were inspected but not independently pairwise regenerated.
